name: Old Havana and its Fortification System
description: Founded by the Spanish in 1519, Old Havana is the historic heart of Cuba's capital, now a city of about 2 million people. Its streets are lined with Baroque and neoclassical buildings, and with arcaded houses featuring balconies, wrought-iron gates and hidden courtyards. A once-major Caribbean shipbuilding port, it is also defended by a system of fortifications.
